## 394fc1eaa85e

**A2 — reproduced synthetic coverage gap, not a canonical-fitting shortcut.**
Selected version 2.0.0. Generator SHA-256:
`28492142df94a17f60b5c4e9718d4751e5bb29d90f9c2a2ace9998afefb924f8`.
Executed/canonical rule hash: `bc441550caa9`; rule text SHA-256:
`27410f2471b6359f4759a8d0725d6ac7c419fa28499872079a6f820d87473714`.

The rule paints an open cell cyan when its finite BFS distances from the red and
green seeds are equal; color-five walls block paths. A tempting wrong rule also
paints cells unreachable from both seeds, treating their distances as infinity
and concluding infinity equals infinity.

At seed 7, indices 0–11 in easy/medium/hard, all 36 generated inputs pass self-check
and strict validation and match canonical Racket outputs. Each of the four wall
profiles appears three times per band. Every one of the 36 has **zero unreachable
open cells**, so the infinity-equality rival fits all 36. All 24 overlapping
three-demo/one-query windows (starts 0–7 per band) pass the task's lesson hook.
This demonstrates the omitted distinction in this sampled synthetic curriculum;
it is not a proof that all possible seeds omit it.

Counterexample: a 9×11 zero grid with red at (7,2), green at (7,8), and a color-five
3×3 perimeter spanning rows 1–3 and columns 4–6. Its center (2,5) is an isolated
open cell. `self_check=[]`, `strict_canonical_like=[]`; Racket leaves that center
**0**, while the intentional infinity-equality rival paints **8**. This belongs
to the validator-accepted BFS input grammar but not the four ordinary wall
construction templates. The saved 37 inputs (36 ordinary plus this island) all
have error-free Racket outputs and Python-mirror parity.

Important disconfirmation: the infinity-equality rival fits **4/5 canonical
pairs, not all five**. The initial stronger possibility that it was fully
canonical-indistinguishable was tested and rejected. One canonical example
already teaches this distinction; the measured issue is that sampled synthetic
lessons lose that support. Separately, none of the five existing declared
canonical shortcuts fits every canonical pair (counts 0/5, 2/5, 0/5, 0/5, 0/5),
so those declarations deserve correction but are not changed in this audit.

**Evidence:** `checks/audit/394fc1eaa85e/counterexample.json`, `probe.json`,
`verified-summary.json`, `racket.json`; reproducer `checks/audit/probe_audits.py`
and canonical-rival check `checks/audit/complete_receipts.py`.
**Recommendation:** either include an unreachable-cell teaching example in the
synthetic lesson policy or explicitly narrow the teaching domain; retain
finite-reachability rivals even when canonical examples already refute them.
Audit only; no reference or generator repair applied.

triage.reason: Retain reported bf097cbccabe override/validation findings and 394fc1eaa85e reachability gap. The latter rival fits 4/5 canonical examples, not all; audit targets unchanged.

## 394fc1eaa85e

**No issue found in the bounded audit.**

I checked the graph-distance semantics, strict input grammar, exact dimension overrides, deterministic four-profile schedule, declared witnesses/rivals, lesson-window identifiability, and parity with the canonical Racket authority. The selected task suite passed 42/42 tests (`checks/audit/394fc1eaa85e/task-tests/result.json`).

An independent probe generated 64 unique scenes spanning all three difficulty labels, exact dimensions 7..9 × 11..13, and 16 examples of each profile (`none`, `vertical_gate`, `horizontal_gate`, `elbow_gate`). All 64 passed `self_check` and `strict_canonical_like`, all mirror cells were exact ARC integers, and 48 overlapping three-demo lesson windows had no surviving declared rivals. Evidence: `checks/audit/394fc1eaa85e/probe-report.json`.

The supported `arcpuzzles apply` command labelled all 64 inputs with canonical rule hash `bc441550caa9`; every output was valid and all 64 matched the independent Python mirror exactly. Evidence: `checks/audit/394fc1eaa85e/racket.json` and `checks/audit/394fc1eaa85e/racket-parity.json`.

Limit: this finite audit did not prove correctness for every legal wall topology or every undeclared heuristic. A full battery attempt was interrupted after lint/self-check and is retained as incomplete under `checks/audit/394fc1eaa85e/battery/`; I do not count it as a pass.
